title: Stage representation of sections of an etale sheaf colimit
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a commutative ring. Let $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ be its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and let $G:\mathcal I\to\mathrm{Mod}(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$ be a diagram of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], indexed by a small filtered category $\mathcal I$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $(H,(c_i))$ be a colimit cocone of $G$. Let $U\to X$ be an object whose underlying scheme is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For every section $t\in H(U)$, there exist an object $i$ of $\mathcal I$ and $s\in G_i(U)$ such that $(c_i)_U(s)=t$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0738 (lemma-directed-colimits-sections), proof of part (4), applied to the etale site as in Etale Cohomology, Tag 03Q4 (section-colimit)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-section-colimit-local-lifts] to t. This yields a finite covering f_b : V_b → U with quasi-compact overlaps, one diagram stage i, and local sections s_b whose colimit images are t restricted to each member.

On each intrinsic pullback V_b ×_U V_b′, cocone naturality and the pullback equation imply that the difference of the restrictions of s_b and s_b′ has zero image in H. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-section-colimit-eventual-zero] to this difference, using compactness of that overlap. Choose the resulting killing arrow a_{bb′} : i → k_{bb′}.

Use Mathlib IsFiltered.wideSpan on the finite family of all a_{bb′}. It gives g : i → j and q_{bb′} : k_{bb′} → j with a_{bb′} ≫ q_{bb′} = g. Functoriality, naturality, and linearity show that the transported sections s_j,b agree on every pullback. Pullback.lift extends compatibility to every cone over two covering arrows.

Encode a section s as a module morphism from ULift Λ by r ↦ r.down • s. Apply Mathlib Presheaf.IsSheaf.existsUnique_amalgamation_ofArrows to the resulting compatible morphisms for G_j to obtain y over U. Cocone naturality and Presheaf.IsSheaf.hom_ext_ofArrows for H show y ≫ (c_j)_U equals r ↦ r.down • t. Evaluate at ULift.up 1 to obtain a global stage section with image t. This proof handles an empty covering without a nonempty-family hypothesis: wideSpan supplies a stage and the sheaf existence and uniqueness clauses apply to the empty family.

lean.statement: theorem etale_section_colimit_representative (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ] (U : X.Etale) [CompactSpace U.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.left] (I : Type w) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (G : I ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{max v w} Λ)) (c : Cocone G) (hc : IsColimit c) : ∀ t : c.pt.obj.obj (Opposite.op U), ∃ (i : I) (s : (G.obj i).obj.obj (Opposite.op U)), ((c.ι.app i).hom.app (Opposite.op U)).hom s = t
